item.title: Photos show Trump touring White House ballroom construction after crushing Republican election loss
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump spent the day after his party’s major election defeat touring his new White House ballroom, where he signed the final steel beam before it was raised into place Wednesday.

item.title: Bob Dylan comes knockin' on pope's door as Leo welcomes legend to Vatican
